name: music-recognizer
title: Music Recognizer
description: Identify the song playing on your PC by recording a few seconds of system audio.
author: erenalparslan

commands.name: recognize
commands.title: Recognize
commands.description: Listen to what's playing and identify the song.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: AudD API Token
preferences.description: Your personal AudD API token from dashboard.audd.io. AudD offers a limited free trial; continued use needs a paid AudD plan.

preferences.name: duration
preferences.title: Recording Duration
preferences.description: How long to record system audio before recognition. 5 seconds is usually plenty; longer clips only help when the recording is noisy.

preferences.name: primaryService
preferences.title: Primary Music Service
preferences.description: Shown as the first action after a match, so pressing Enter opens the song there.
